## Problem

What are you trying to do that the server doesn't support today? Describe the
use case, not just the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see: a new tool, an option, a behavior change. If it maps to
a Mural API endpoint, link the
[API reference](https://developers.mural.co/public/docs).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why they fall short.

## Scope

- [ ] Read-only (no data is modified in Mural)
- [ ] Write operation (creates/updates/deletes data in Mural)

## Additional context

Anything else: examples, links.
